parent_objective: run a fresh public repeat of the corrected profile pilot using fixed new seed and eval blocks
blocked_by: M1211 pre-registers the repeat protocol but no fresh repeat has run
supersedes: deciding from the single M1209 seed block
invalidates: claiming stable L3 or L2 trends without fresh public repeat

public_gates: M1212 may run the fresh corrected public repeat only
M1212 may run PPO under the fixed M1211 repeat budget and seeds
M1212 must evaluate every checkpoint on the same fresh public eval seeds
M1212 must not use private holdout
M1212 must not tune profiles based on M1209 or partial M1212 results
M1212 must not run candidate replay
M1212 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
M1212 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune hyperparameters after seeing profile results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage or self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a fresh public repeat to test whether M1209 L3-family and L2-control trends are stable
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public repeat trend only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile cannot run the fixed repeat protocol
stop if protocol changes after seeing a profile result
stop if corrected controls are bypassed during training or evaluation
fallback_plan: if the repeat is incomplete, record failures and route to runner or resource audit
if trends match M1209, route to combined result synthesis
if trends conflict with M1209, route to seed-fragility audit
if online GRU beats reset-control under pre-registered thresholds, route to stronger history-causality gates

admission_evidence: M1209 provided public pilot capability evidence with all seed runs complete
M1210 audited proof/control gates and blocked claim expansion due L2 current-tiled parity and L3 reset parity
M1211 provides rollback protection by fixing the repeat protocol before training and requiring no promotion private holdout or tuning
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all selected profiles run with fixed budgets or failures are recorded
profile seed rows and aggregate rows are recorded
claim scope remains public repeat only
next audit or synthesis milestone is selected

repeat_protocol.eval_seed_policy: same fresh 64 public eval seeds for every profile checkpoint

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1212 repeats current-tiled controls because M1210 keeps current-frame substitution risk active.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1212 may test trend repeatability but still cannot prove causal self-ID without later matched-history gates.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repeat again shows L2/current-tiled parity or L3/reset parity, record it as negative evidence and route to synthesis or architecture repair.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fresh public seed block can test whether M1209 corrected profile trends are repeatable without private holdout or tuning.
success_criteria: all selected profile seed runs complete or failures are recorded
no promotion or actor-input contract change occurs
claims are limited to fresh public repeat trends
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets or hyperparameters change after seeing results
metrics are framed as paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
failed profiles are omitted from summary
corrected controls are not applied in training or evaluation

commands.name: run_corrected_profile_repeat
commands.command: run fixed fresh public corrected L0/L1/L2/L3 profile repeat with equal seeds budgets and eval protocol

decision_rule: M1212 passes if the fixed fresh public repeat runs or records failures without claim expansion or protocol drift.
